meta.purpose: Cross-check of NASA POWER against GPM IMERG over the UbiMap pilot grid
meta.power_source: NASA POWER climatology (MERRA-2 derived, about 50 km)
meta.imerg_source: GPM IMERG via NASA GIBS WMTS
meta.imerg_period: 25 complete calendar years, 2001-01-01 to 2025-12-31. 9124 daily composites (P1D) read, 25 years for every calendar month. The GIBS gap 2025-10-23 to 2025-10-29 has no published tile and is excluded.
